original_transaction_value.note: The amount of this capture. Refunds are not reflected; the capture may be one of several on the order.

disputed_amount.note: No dispute exists or none has been read; the disputed amount is not assumed from the transaction value.

potential_seller_exposure.note: Not derived from the original transaction value or from the disputed amount. Defining it needs a separately reviewed policy change.
